description: This file defines configuration options, validation, and related classes for the Redis-based Grain Directory in Orleans. It includes classes for setting Redis connection options, creating connection multiplexers, and validating configurations.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis grain directory, including connection options, multiplexer creation delegate, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting Redis configuration details, especially passwords.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, ensuring required configuration is present.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to create a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously using provided configuration options.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Method to redact sensitive information from ConfigurationOptions, overriding base RedactAttribute method.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the Redis configuration options are set; throws exception if invalid.
